title: Kitchen activity zones and layout
intro: A kitchen layout connects storage, washing, preparation, cooking and serving. Compare alternatives against the same users, use scenario and movement requirements.

sections.title: Map the work zones
sections.text: Map a meal from retrieving ingredients through washing, preparation, cooking and serving, including returning utensils and handling waste. Multiple users or appliances change these relationships. A three-point triangle may support analysis but cannot by itself validate the entire kitchen.
sections.caption: Include work, serving and return paths.

sections.title: Test openings and movement
sections.text: Draw open appliance doors and drawers with standing and walking positions. Test credible simultaneous activities, such as preparation and retrieval. Closed-door space does not establish usable space during opening. Give every conflict a code, affected elements and triggering use state.
sections.caption: Review simultaneous use, not only a static gap.

sections.title: Compare with consistent criteria
sections.text: Compare feasible alternatives against user routes, usable preparation surface, appliance opening, service access and storage. Attach plan evidence and flag missing site or device data. More cabinets or a more expensive appearance does not automatically improve the layout.
sections.caption: A plan and conflict log justify the decision.

example.title: Worked case and decision
example.text: A preparation drawer conflicts with the dishwasher door in A. B resolves the conflict but reduces preparation surface. Record that trade-off and check the remaining surface with the user before selecting it.
example.decision: Decision: resolve the conflict while retaining the required preparation function.

quiz.question: What best supports layout acceptance?
quiz.explanation: The evidence must address actual work and movement.

assignment.prompt: Submit two layouts, a meal scenario, three opening states and a conflict/decision record.

faq.question: Does a work triangle validate the kitchen?
faq.answer: No. Review the complete tasks, users, devices and movement states.
